ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to enforce sequential OCV event versions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(OCV_Event_Version__c), OCV_Event_Version__c < PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c), NOT(ISNULL(OCV_Event_Version__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: LOW VERSION: Event Version lower than existing Version.
